messages:
Ana: Morning! Quick newbie Q: where do I post these so they get seen fast — laptop order, service API key, and a flaky unit test failing locally?

onboarding-bot: Welcome Ana :tada: Short map: laptop -> #people-ops via `/claim-laptop`; API keys -> #support (product) or #eng (infra) using `/request-api-key`; flaky tests -> #eng with branch + failing command, only escalate to #eng-oncall if CI/prod is blocked.

Kai: Tip: open a separate thread for each item and prefix with tags like `[laptop]` `[keys]` `[test]`. Makes triage/search way easier.

Ana: Is it okay to ping someone directly for faster approvals?

ops-team: Ping approvers if urgent, but include context (ticket link, ETA). For regular requests use the channel so it's auditable. Use :thumbsup: to ack resolution.

Ana: Any quick bot commands I should run first?

onboarding-bot: Try `/setup-checklist` -> DM checklist, `/claim-laptop`, `/request-api-key`, `/intro` -> posts intro to #new-hires.

Ana: Thanks! I'll run the checklist and open three threads now.
